👮 **Wachiman** · review of the whole pull request, at `eca3319`: all 2 files reviewed.

3 finding(s): 3 to consider; 3 on their lines. Reply in a comment's thread to answer it.

### Summary

The change adds `synchronize` to the review triggers and records why in an ADR 0028 amendment. I found no defects, only three things to consider:

1. **Draft pull requests:** I couldn't confirm whether the reusable workflow skips them. GitHub also sends `synchronize` for pushes to drafts, so if the engine doesn't skip them, every push to a draft gets a paid Opus review.
2. **Cancelling runs:** the amendment says a newer push cancels a running review. That depends on the engine's own concurrency setting, because this repository's workflow has no `concurrency:` block.
3. **Out-of-date ADR text:** the Status row and the earlier amendment still name `niway-dev/wachi-reviewer` pinned to v1.2.0. The workflow actually calls `niway-dev/wachiman` at v1.3.0, and no amendment records that change. The frontmatter description also still says each pull request is reviewed once.

> ℹ️ No critical issues — two gaps in the amendment and some docs left stale. **Reviewed changes** Reviewed the trigger change and the ADR 0028 amendment against the pinned engine (`niway-dev/wachiman` `v1.3.0` — `review.yml` and `src/engine.ts`). The trigger works as described: the `review` job requires `draft == false`, so pushes to drafts are skipped. The `review` and `on-demand` jobs use separate per-PR concurrency groups, so a push never cancels a `/wachi review`. A rebase or force-push does fall back to a full review (`compare` status ≠ `ahead`). - **`agent-review.yml` trigger** — `synchronize` is added to the `pull_request` types, so every push to a ready PR now gets a review of the changes since the last reviewed commit. - **ADR 0028 amendment** — The Status row links to the new amendment, the rejected alternative is marked as reversed, and a new section records the #475 evidence and the known costs. ### ℹ️ Other docs still say the review runs once, when the PR is ready After this change, several docs still describe the old trigger. A reader who lands on them will think pushes are not reviewed.
Technical details ````markdown # Stale descriptions of the review trigger ## Affected sites - `apps/documentation/src/content/docs/architecture/decisions/0028-advisory-claude-review-on-pull-requests.mdx:3` — frontmatter `description`: "reviews each pull request once when it is ready" (this text is the page's meta and search snippet). - `apps/documentation/src/content/docs/deployment/ci-cd-pipelines.md:182-183` — "posts a Claude code review on a pull request when it is ready for review, and on the owner's `/wachi review` comment". - Pre-existing, but the Status row this PR edits still names `niway-dev/wachi-reviewer` pinned to `v1.2.0`, while the workflow calls `niway-dev/wachiman/...@v1.3.0`, and no amendment covers that rename/bump. ## Required outcome - The `description` and `ci-cd-pipelines.md` mention the review on every push. - Optionally, the Status row names the engine and tag the workflow actually uses. ````
